domain_judgments.rationale: Follow-up was nearly complete with minimal missing outcome data (less than 2% across primary endpoints), equally distributed across study arms.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Vital status was assessed in all the patients but 1 (in the placebo group; 0.1% of the patients in the combined groups) at 30 days and in all the patients but 8 (4 patients in each group; 0.9% of the patients in the combined groups) at 90 days. ... Data were missing for 7 patients in the levosimendan group and for 11 in the placebo group.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objectively defined clinical endpoints and adjudicated by an independent clinical-events committee blinded to treatment assignments.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Preoperative and postoperative electrocardiograms and levels of creatine kinase MB in all patients were reviewed by an independent clinical-events committee whose members were unaware of the trial-group assignments.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial had a published protocol and statistical analysis plan registered in advance (NCT02025621), and reported all prespecified primary and secondary outcomes according to the plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The design of this multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial has been described previously. The trial protocol, which is available with the full text of this article at NEJM.org, was approved by the institutional review board or ethics committee at each participating site.

overall_summary: This was a rigorously conducted, double-blind, multicenter randomized controlled trial with concealed Web-based allocation, excellent protocol adherence, near-complete follow-up, and blinded outcome adjudication. All domains were assessed as low risk of bias.
